title: introduce-schema-fallback-profiles-for-tool-calls-and-streaming-compat
author: Marco Liang
description: Motivation: Recent schema evolution (typed tool outputs + streaming envelope change) introduced subtle incompatibilities for long-lived clients and server-side streaming consumers. This PR provides a pragmatic, opt-in compatibility layer that: 1) lets routes advertise supported schema profiles, 2) negotiates per-request schema behavior via headers, and 3) supplies server-side shims for legacy clients to preserve streaming stability and structured output semantics. Summary of changes: added a small version-negotiation header (X-Redwood-Schema-Version) and an opt-in beta acceptance header (X-Redwood-Accept-Schema-Beta) to the public API surface; implemented three server-side profiles (legacy, compat-v2, strict-v3) that drive transformation behavior in the runtime and gateway; introduced streaming envelope adapters that rewrite chunked outputs on the fly to maintain existing streaming formats for legacy clients while emitting richer typed events to v3-aware clients; extended function/tool calling plumbing to include optional typed-output annotations and a fallback converter that maps typed outputs into the legacy name/value arrays when the legacy profile is negotiated; added route-level default mapping in deployment configs allowing customers to opt their dedicated/private routes to a chosen profile; added deprecation telemetry and warnings emitted in responses when clients specify deprecated schema versions; included a migration guide and audit script to list routes still using legacy defaults. Implementation notes: runtime changes are intentionally isolated to runtime/streaming-adapter.* and gateway/schema-negotiate.*; converters are small, well-tested translation layers with explicit unit tests that cover edge cases (partial streams, out-of-order tool events, KV-cache-prefixed tokens). Rollout plan: feature is behind a feature flag and disabled by default for hosted API; we will enable compat-v2 as an automatic fallback for older SDK agent user agents during a limited rollout; after two weeks of telemetry we will open the beta opt-in for customers and communicate migration steps. Related work items: ENG-5132 (schema negotiation design), ENG-5190 (streaming envelope adapter), SUP-987 (customer reported regression in tool outputs). No user-facing breaking changes are applied automatically; customers must opt into strict-v3. See release_notes for migration instructions and opt-in steps.

release_notes: Added opt-in schema negotiation headers and per-route schema profiles (legacy, compat-v2, strict-v3). Runtime includes adapters that maintain streaming stability for legacy clients while enabling typed tool outputs for v3 consumers. No automatic breaking changes; customers must opt into strict-v3. See docs/migration/schema-versioning.md for steps.
